thread:
Sara: heads up — after the RBAC prune last night we started seeing intermittent TLS handshake failures (0.2-0.7%) between edge-proxy and model-router in eu-west-1. symptoms: "certificate verify failed: unknown CA" in envoy logs.
Miguel: do we know if the cert rotator or KMS role change landed in that region around the same time?
Sara: yes, the IAM scope tighten landed at ~00:12 UTC — I can see the rotator pod restarting a few times. rotator-bot also logged a bunch of decrypt errors.
oncall-bot: alert: tls-handshake-failures spike detected (eu-west-1) — affected services: edge-proxy, model-router.
Anya-Sec: possible hypothesis: rotator lost kms:Decrypt for ephemeral signing key -> it failed to publish the new intermediate CA to the proxy chain, causing clients validating the chain to drop the handshake. can someone paste the rotator logs?
Sara: paste from rotator: ```
2026-03-23T00:13:02Z rotator ERROR decrypt failed: AccessDenied: user "role/rotator-eu-west" is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111111:key/abcd-ef01
at rotator/keystore.go:142
```
Miguel: confirmed — that IAM policy change removed the kms:Decrypt on the rotator role as part of the scope-reduction PR. I reverted the PR in staging but not prod. mitigation options: 1) re-add kms:Decrypt to role for eu-west, 2) scale up legacy cert-cache TTL to stop evictions until rotator fixed, 3) manual one-off rotate with admin creds.
Anya-Sec: immediate steps: (A) patch IAM to restore kms:Decrypt for role rotator-eu-west (least friction) (B) correlate audit logs for kms:Denied entries so we can scope impact. run this query on auditbot: `service:kms AND eventName:Decrypt AND errorCode:AccessDenied AND resource:abcd-ef01 AND region:eu-west-1`
Devops: quick validation commands for ops — run against a failing host to see chain issues: ```
# check TLS handshake with s_client
openssl s_client -connect model-router.eu-west-1.internal:443 -servername model-router \n# list cert chain
``` also curl with verbose to show verify errors: `curl -v --tlsv1.3 https://model-router.internal/health`
Miguel: I'm applying the IAM patch now to restore kms:Decrypt on rotator-eu-west for the specific key. I'll coordinate with security to scope a narrower policy afterwards.
Sara: after IAM change, rotator caught up and pushed new intermediate. envoy metrics showed handshake failures drop to baseline within ~90s. I ran `openssl s_client -showcerts` and chain looks good.
Anya-Sec: post-incident action items: 1) adjust RBAC rollout playbook to include a canary step that validates rotator decrypts per region, 2) add a telemetry tag `rotator:region` to audit logs emitted on decrypt failure so we can quickly scope, 3) add automated runbook that triggers a temporary cert-cache TTL bump when rotator decrypt failure rate > 0.1%. I'll own the runbook and dashboard.
Miguel: assigning tasks — @Miguel will push IAM rollbacks + tighter follow-up policy, @Sara will run the manual rotate for any leftover stale certs, @Anya-Sec will create the dashboard and runbook.
Devops: noting the change for release notes (rbac: brief rollback to restore rotator decrypt perms in eu-west).
Sara: thanks — confirm all done? :thumbsup:
Miguel: done, rotator role patched and audit query results attached to ticket #SEC-2026. :white_check_mark:
Anya-Sec: creating the postmortem doc and calendar for follow-up tomorrow. closing thread for now. :lock:
